The cofactor contribution from g is a closed-orbit total derivative; pairing theta with pi-theta makes the remaining log multiplier -2epsilon*kappa*r^2 times a strictly positive integral, without sign ambiguity or numerical inference. Three independently selected admissible parameter tuples passed direct original-vs-paired quadrature.
